versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the official GPT Image 2-based image generation skill for API易平台.
- Supports both image creation (from prompt) and image editing (with reference images); also allows multi-image fusion.
- Provides precise control over image size (including 4K), quality, and output format.
- Compatible with Node.js (preferred) and Python; CLI scripts included.
- Utilizes API易平台 official endpoints: /v1/images/generations and /v1/images/edits.
- Token-based billing; pure base64 output (without prefix); multipart/form-data upload for editing.
- Detailed usage guides, parameter descriptions, and troubleshooting instructions provided.
